text:
micah: Quick sync — I have SDK PR #2147 that changes the auth header shape. It needs API PR #431 to land first and console PR #890 to update usage. Runtime image also needs bump to v2.1. Can we sequence merges this week?

olivia: Thanks. API PR #431 is review-ready but needs a tiny doc tweak for the SASL header. @rahul can you take a look?

rahul: I can pick it up today. If tests pass we can merge by EOD. Is this a breaking contract change or a safe rename?

micah: Minor rename only: `x-rdwd-user` -> `x-rdwd-subject`. Tests failed in console e2e only. Console PR #890 has a stub; @jen is fixing the client parsing.

jen: On it — hit a CSS flake unrelated to this, pushing a fix in a few mins. Will also add a defensive parse so console won't blow up during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: console-core v1.12.3 -> canary group 3 at 4132110200

olivia: :thumbsup: If rahul gives +1 on API, plan should be API -> SDK -> Console. SDK depends on API; console safe after SDK forwards headers.

rahul: Left a small comment on API PR about header parsing fallback. If micah adds that, I'm +1.

micah: Pushed a tiny fallback into SDK PR to accept both headers for 48h. PR #2147 updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2147

sam: Heads up on the helm side — charts reference runtime image tag in `charts/values.yaml`. We'll need a patch to point to v2.1, and runtime team must publish the image. @platform-runtime please confirm.

taylor: We're building runtime v2.1 today; ETA artifact push ~2:00pm PT. Once published, sam can open the helm PR. Ping me when you're ready and I'll coordinate the rollout order.

jen: Console fix merged -> rolling canary. micah, after SDK merges, can you add a temporary feature flag so we can flip header handling gradually?

micah: Yes. I'll add a flag `legacy_header_mode` defaulted on for 24h then switch off. I'll include rollout notes and a migration checklist.

olivia: Proposed plan: rahul merges API after small change (today), micah merges SDK after green CI, jen merges console fix, sam opens helm values PR once runtime image published, taylor confirms image push. If all green, target merge window 3:00pm PT. Everyone OK?

rahul: OK.

jen: sg.

 taylor: ack.

micah: on it.

 deploy-bot: Reminder: merge window 3:00pm PT (automated).
